Let q_1<q_2<… be primes with q_{n+1}−q_n ≥ q_n−q_{n−1}. Then liminf q_n/n² ≥ 1/κ'_S for
S={3,5,7,11,13}, where κ'_S = (ρ_S+E0_S)/M, M=15015, ρ_S=18748, E0_S=15.13085 (defined below); numerically
liminf q_n/n² ≥ 0.80024. Also (same method) S={3,5,7}: ρ=156, ≥0.63555; S={3,…,11}: ρ=1596, ≥0.71859.

Let P ≥ 1 and r* ∈ Z/P, and let m(r*) = 2 and m(r) = 1 for r ≠ r* (one repeated gap per period, average
multiplicity 1 + 1/P). This pattern is never Ẑ-good: it fails mod some prime ≤ max(7, P).

Let w(k) = loglog k/log k. Fix ε ∈ (0,1). There is N₀(ε) such that for all N ≥ N₀, the number of n ≤ N for which there is NO k ∈ (K/2, K] with ω(n+k)·w(k) ≥ (ε/10)·logloglog N is at most N·exp(−(log N)^{1−ε}). Here K = ⌊(log N)^{1−ε/2}⌋. In particular F(n) ≥ (ε/10)·logloglog N for all n ≤ N outside a set of that size. For each fixed C the same bound holds for #{n ≤ N : F(n) < C} once N ≥ N₀(C, ε).

Let w(k)=log log k/log k. There is an effectively computable N0 such that for every n ≥ N0 there is k with
17 ≤ k ≤ 30046 and ω(n+k)·w(k) ≥ 7·w(30046) > 1.58403. Hence F(n) ≥ 1.584 for n ≥ N0, i.e. liminf F(n) ≥ 1.584.

Write L3 = logloglog N, and let E_C(N) = {n ≤ N : F(n) < C}, with F(n) = sup_k ω(n+k)·w(k) and w(k) = loglog k/log k.
(a) For every fixed C > 0, |E_C(N)| ≤ N·exp(−(log N)^{1−(C+o(1))/L3}) as N → ∞.
(b) For every fixed θ ∈ (0,1) and θ' > θ, |E_{θ·L3}(N)| ≤ N·exp(−(log N)^{1−θ'}) for N ≥ N₀(θ, θ').
There is N₀ (effective in principle) such that for every n ≥ N₀ there is some k with 4 ≤ k ≤ 30033 and ω(n+k)w(k) ≥ 7w(30033) = 1.58406915…. Hence liminf F(n) ≥ 7w(30033).

For $n\ge1$ and $D\ge0$, let $\mathcal F(n,D)$ be the set of $w:\{0,\dots,D\}\to[0,1]$ with $\sum w=n$, $w(0)>0$, $w(D)>0$, and $(w\star\tilde w)(d):=\sum_z w(z)w(z+d)\le1$ for every $d\ne0$. Every Sidon $A\subset[0,D]$ with $0,D\in A$ and $|A|=n$ has $1_A\in\mathcal F(n,D)$. Put $W(x)=\sum_{z\le x}w(z)$, $W'(x)=\sum_{z\ge D-x}w(z)$ and $x_j=2^{-j}D$, and define
$\Phi(w)=\sum_{j\ge1,\,x_j\ge n}(\lambda_j^{-2}+\lambda_j'^{-2})$ with $\lambda_j=nW(\lfloor x_j\rfloor)/x_j$ and $\lambda'_j$ defined likewise from $W'$. (This is the G1 functional; edge Cauchy–Schwarz gives $Q(A)\gtrsim\Phi(1_A)$.)
(a) Upper bound. Suppose $0<\delta\le1/2$, $\delta n^2\ge41$ and $n^2\ge3/\delta$, and set $D=\lfloor(1+\delta)n^2\rfloor$. Then some $w\in\mathcal F(n,D)$ has $\sum w^2\le1$ (so also $w\le1$, $w\star\tilde w\le1$ and $w*w\le1$ at every lag) and $\Phi(w)\le2(1+2\delta)^2(\log_2(1/\delta)+4.1)$.
(b) Lower bound. Suppose $n\ge16$, $3n^{-1/2}\le\delta\le1/2$ and $D\le(1+\delta)n^2$. Then every $w\in\mathcal F(n,D)$ has $\Phi(w)\ge(\log_2(1/\delta)-2)/18$.

Let q_1 < q_2 < ... be primes with q_{n+1}-q_n >= q_n-q_{n-1}. Then liminf q_n/n^2 >= 1/rho_17 >= 0.86429.
Here rho_17 = G_17/M + tau_17 with M = 3·5·7·11·13·17 = 255255, G_17 = 295318 and
tau_z = sum_{p>z} (p-2)(1-1/p)/prod_{3<=l<p} l, so tau_17 = 0.0000675 and rho_17 = 1.157020.
Equivalently d_n >= (2/rho_17 - o(1)) n.

Let q_1<q_2<… be primes with d_i=q_{i+1}−q_i nondecreasing and e_i=d_{i+1}−d_i. Fix θ<2/3 and C≥1. For all n≥n_0(θ,C) with q_n≤Cn², #{i∈[n/2,3n/4] : e_{i+1}≠e_i} > n^θ. (Note Δ³q_i=e_{i+1}−e_i.) Hence, if #{i≤n:Δ³q_i≠0}≤n^θ for all large n, then q_n/n²→∞. The constants are ineffective, via Siegel.

Let q_1<q_2<… be primes with d_i=q_{i+1}−q_i nondecreasing and e_i=d_{i+1}−d_i. Fix θ<2/3 and C≥1. For all n≥n_0(θ,C) with q_n≤Cn², #{i∈[n/2,3n/4] : e_{i+1}≠e_i} > n^θ. (Note Δ³q_i=e_{i+1}−e_i.) Hence, if #{i≤n:Δ³q_i≠0}≤n^θ for all large n, then q_n/n²→∞. The constants are ineffective, via Siegel.

Let q_1<q_2<… be primes with nondecreasing gaps g_i=q_{i+1}−q_i, and let e_i=g_{i+1}−g_i. Fix θ<3/4 and C≥1. For all n≥n_0(θ,C) with q_n≤Cn²: #{i∈[n/2,3n/4] : e_{i+1}≠e_i} > n^θ. Hence if #{i≤n : Δ³q_i≠0} ≤ n^θ for all large n, then q_n/n²→∞. (n_0 is ineffective, through Siegel.)
